<thought>All measured resistances are consistent with a single series chain of nodes from A to B. By ordering the nodes as A‑X1‑N_b1‑N_b2‑N_b3‑X2‑N_c1‑N_c2‑N_c3‑X3‑N_d1‑N_d2‑B, the resistance between each consecutive pair matches the given data, and every other measurement equals the sum of the intervening segment resistances. Therefore the circuit consists of 12 resistors in series with the values shown.</thought>
